_comment: POSTURE C GPS+GALILEO — 5-ep ESTIMABILITY DUMP.  The 20 min arm
(_pc305_gg_tri_slant_20m) withheld EVERY epoch: NetworkSbasis null-space
gate observed 4-7 (near-)zero eigenvalues (flapping epoch-to-epoch around
the default relative cutoff ~2.87e-04 = 1e-9 x largest ev 2.87e+05) against
a declared S-basis dimension of 2, and drop-and-heal could not attribute
them to any droppable entity — the pre-registered Galileo channel-family
risk, reproduced on slant+GF.  GPS-only posture C emits 10/10 clean on the
SAME build and data, so the new directions come with the E activation.
This arm exists ONLY to NAME those directions: trace_estimability dumps the
spectrum with eigenvector composition (the instrument that identified the
PB|*|L2W common mode on the W6+SH wall).  5 epochs is enough — the gate
sees the null space at epoch 1.
Leading hypothesis to test against the dump: per-family satellite-common
phase-bias modes of the Galileo X-family channels (L1X/L5X/L7X) and/or Q/X
family splits — the pinned pair lives in ONE family, so a station subset
tracking only the other family never observes the pinned channels.
DO NOT arm sbasis_complete here (rung-3 class: cold garbage level).
DO NOT place a rank_gate_tol until the dump proves the directions are true
gauges rather than weak-but-real content (the rung-4 rule: placed from the
config's OWN dump, never globally).
